svg.title: FIG 01 · on-device reading
svg.desc: Blueprint of a TrueRead meter reading: CameraX photo, the TrueRead app, an AIDL call (processReadingV4) to the separate Engine app, a router that prefers one path and allows one fallback, the local ONNX Runtime pipeline (11 INT8 models, decrypted in memory) or the API, then a reading with per-digit confidence. Red pulses are digital reads, cyan analog reads, pink a local failure that falls back to the API.
svg.text: one photo in, one reading out · the models run on the phone, the api is the fallback
TRUEREAD ENGINE · ONNX RUNTIME · 11 × INT8 · AES-GCM FILES, DECRYPTED IN MEMORY
